name: Python asyncio
description: Concurrent Python with asyncio, from the event loop up.

chapters.title: Testing & Debugging asyncio
chapters.topic: Testing and debugging asyncio code: pytest-asyncio (markers, event loop scope, async fixtures), IsolatedAsyncioTestCase, mocking coroutines with AsyncMock, asyncio debug mode (asyncio.run(debug=True), PYTHONASYNCIODEBUG), slow_callback_duration warnings, never-awaited coroutine warnings and tracemalloc, inspecting tasks with asyncio.all_tasks and Task.print_stack, deterministic tests for timeouts.
